research.title: Google Lyria 3 Released - AI Music in Gemini
research.summary: Google releases Lyria 3, new AI for turning ideas into complete music in any genre. Transform simple text prompts or images into 30-second tracks with vocals, instruments, and lyrics. Now free in Gemini app. Lyria 2 API pricing: $0.06 per 30 seconds.

research.title: ElevenLabs Launches AI Music Platform
research.summary: ElevenLabs launches ElevenLabs Music, entering the AI music race with Suno and Udio. Raised $500M in Series D at $11B valuation - largest AI audio round ever.

research.title: Top AI Music Companies 2026
research.summary: Suno generates a Spotify catalog's worth of music every two weeks. Suno raised $1.2B - largest music tech funding round in history. Both Suno and Udio settling lawsuits with major labels and building licensed models.

research.title: ElevenLabs Raises $500M at $11B Valuation
research.summary: AI audio startup ElevenLabs raised $500 million in Series D, valuing the company at $11 billion. Major player in voice and now music AI.

research.title: Music Industry Enters Less-Is-More Era
research.summary: 60,000 wholly AI-generated tracks delivered to streaming services daily. 200+ million songs on platforms. Apple Music flagged 2 billion fraudulent streams in 2025 ($17M in fake royalties).

research.title: Spotify 2025 Payouts - What's Next for Artists
research.summary: Spotify paying $11B+ in 2025. AI being exploited to flood platforms with low-quality 'slop' to game royalties. Spotify introducing AI detection and human editorial priorities.

research.title: Best VST Plugins for Music Production 2026
research.summary: Top VSTs: Serum 2 (legendary wavetable synth), Massive X (Native Instruments), Vital (free, highly rated), MOSAIQ. Also top effects: FabFilter Pro-Q 4, Soundtoys Decapitator, Valhalla SuperMassive.

research.title: Google Adds Music Generation to Gemini
research.summary: Google adds Lyria 3 to Gemini app. 30-second tracks from text or images. Designed for 'original expression, not mimicking existing artists.' Free tier available, AI Plus subscribers get higher limits.

research.title: Gemini Can Now Generate Music
research.summary: Google's Lyria 3 model can now generate 30-second approximations of what real music sounds like. Integrated directly into the Gemini app.

research.title: The AI Music Stack Moves in Sync
research.summary: Suno Studio 1.2 introduced timing control, alternate takes, and expanded meter (time signature) support, adding real precision to AI music production.

research.title: Can AI Music Be Monetized in 2026?
